signals.title: Release evidence
signals.body: The stabilization milestone brewq-4oc defines correctness, workflow review, and installed-artifact gates. Issue completion percentage is not release readiness.

signals.title: Verification is separate
signals.body: This dashboard does not run checks. Run uv run python scripts/verify.py and consult issue evidence for results and outstanding release checks.

notes.title: Product Boundary
notes.body: Read-only query and analytics. No install, uninstall, upgrade, services, Brewfile, TUI, GUI, or multi-package-manager behavior.

notes.title: Current Center
notes.body: Make config, inventory, cache recovery, and output behavior trustworthy before expanding features.

notes.title: Execution order
notes.body: Follow bd ready and milestone dependencies: correctness and contract, workflow review, then artifact verification. Design lives in docs/roadmap.md.
